summary: Hormel Foods disclosed a definitive Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to acquire all outstanding membership interests of Brakebush Brothers, LLC from Brakebush Holdings, Inc. for a $1.055 billion cash base purchase price, subject to customary adjustments. Announced September 29-30, 2026, closing is expected in fiscal Q1 2027, conditioned on HSR and other antitrust clearances, no prohibitory order, and customary reps and covenants. Either party may terminate if not closed by March 29, 2027, with a possible three-month regulatory extension. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium was disclosed; watch antitrust timing and any purchase-price adjustments.
